problems.problem: The declared concept is three stacked colour blocks in SHIFTED olive tones carrying the image weight, but the render shows one near-uniform olive field with three faint hairline seams (approx y=535, y=827, y=1130). The tonal shift between blocks is almost invisible, so the 'ledger' architecture reads as a flat wall with scratch lines and the bottle looks pasted onto a single plane rather than seated within a constructed graphic stack.

Hierarchy inside the left column is loose: the gap from logo baseline (y=523) to title top (y=605) is 82px while the gap from title bottom (y=741) to subtitle (y=864) is 123px, and the gold rule sits another 52px below at y=933. The column drifts instead of reading as one locked ledger entry; against the references' confident type blocks the setting feels tentative. Tracking of 2px on the 72px title also leaves the two wrapped lines slightly airy and uneven in colour.

The bottle base (y=1239) lands inside the bottom block while the seam behind the flacon at y=1130 cuts the body at an arbitrary height, and the middle block - which the brief says carries the whole weight - holds only the title. The visual mass sits low-right with a large inert olive area above the cap (top 34% of canvas empty), so the promised 'middle block carries the weight' balance is not achieved.

Contact detail crop [486,1099,983,1349] confirms the base IS seated: a soft dark contact shadow hugs the full base edge at offset_y=0, no floating. However the shadow is a neutral soft smudge on a declared shadowless flat-graphic field; it reads slightly photographic against the matte panels, a minor mode inconsistency rather than a floating fault.

References (007 rose burst, Escentric Molecule graphic circles, Versace tonal field) each commit fully to one bold visual device. This poster's device - the stacked tonal blocks - is present only as hairlines, so the execution sits at competent-generic rather than resolved campaign grade.

changes.value: Three wide horizontal matte painted plywood panels stacked edge to edge, clearly shifted olive green tones: pale sage olive top block, deep olive middle block, mid olive bottom block, crisp hard seams between blocks, perfectly even shadowless flat illumination, no texture gradients, no objects, no horizon
